working_geometry_plain: The working L1 geometry is a bounded finite-chi boundary-MPS environment readout carried by PEPS3D anchors. Finite spinor-derived site densities seed local PEPS3D tensors on K=(V,E,F,C). Boundary sites are scanned by finite chi MPS transfer matrices to produce environment signatures, cyclic trace-closure residuals, local order-gap readouts, and QIT entropy/cut readouts. This is still a local finite layer lego, not layer stacking and not a full PEPS3D environment theorem.
finite_map: L1_EK_chi : (K=(V,E,F,C), finite PEPS3D local tensors T_v, finite boundary surface partial order, finite chi in {2,4}, finite projective paths A->B and B->A) -> finite boundary-MPS environment signatures, cyclic boundary closure residuals, order-gap readouts, and local QIT entropy/cut readouts
domain: finite PEPS3D carriers K for shapes (2,2,2), (4,2,2), (4,4,2), (4,4,4); finite anchors V,E,F,C; finite spinors {|0>,|1>,|+>,|->}; finite spinor-derived densities rho_v; finite local tensors with bond_dim=2 and physical effect index; finite boundary-MPS chi in {2,4}; finite paths {Z0->X+, X+->Z0}
codomain_or_output: finite boundary-site lists, finite boundary-MPS tensor/matrix rows, environment singular signatures, cyclic trace-closure residuals, sequential boundary order gaps, local von Neumann/Renyi2/MI/conditional/coherent entropy readouts, tool-ablation statuses, and 8/16/32/64 stress summaries
F01_witness: finite K=(V,E,F,C), spinors, densities, probes/effects, projective paths, local PEPS3D tensors, finite chi boundary-MPS matrices, entropy readouts, and stress rows
N01_witness: Z0->X+ and X+->Z0 projective paths produce different boundary-MPS environment signatures while order-erased same-projector control collapses
torch_spinor_or_density: torch-native two-component spinors {|0>,|1>,|+>,|->}; densities rho_v = psi_v psi_v^dagger; local PEPS3D tensors and boundary-MPS matrices are torch complex tensors
entropy_status: von Neumann, Renyi2, mutual information, conditional entropy, and coherent information run on local boundary environment/cut readouts
scale_status: 8/16/32/64 PEPS3D site stress passed at bond_dim=2 and boundary-MPS chi in {2,4}; dense global state/environment closure not used
controls_that_hold: boundary anchor erasure or illegal boundary rejection
